summary: Tri-Ace and Square Enix's standalone PS2 action RPG built around Radiata City, branching story paths, and a large recruitable cast.

emulation.notes: Use legal disc dumps and test visual effects before a full capture.

primary.why: Radiata Stories only released on PlayStation 2, and PCSX2 upscaling is the highest-fidelity way to capture the complete game.
primary.how_to_play: Use a legally dumped PS2 disc image in PCSX2 at high internal resolution. Plan for at least two runs if you want to see both major story branches and recruitment outcomes.
